job: Two drives have failed in the data hall: one high up in row A at U40 and one low down in row B at U10. Pull both sled caddies and bring the last one out to the staging bench outside the hall.
understood_as: Pull the failed drive sleds from bay U40 in row A and bay U10 in row B of the data hall, and carry the second one out to the staging bench outside the hall.
steps: Go to row A and pull the drive sled from bay U40.
Go to row B and pull the drive sled from bay U10.
Carry that last sled out of the hall to the staging bench.

demos.why: Shows how the hand releases the sled latch or handle and slides the caddy straight out of the bay without catching it.
Shows how firmly to hold the sled handle so the drive does not slip or drop, without bending the handle or caddy.

questions: What should happen to the first sled pulled (row A, U40)? As written it is pulled but left in the hall. Should it also go to the staging bench?
The only exit the system knows is the general way out of the hall. Can you confirm the staging bench sits on that route, or have someone locate it as an anchor?
You did not mention fitting replacement drives, so none are planned. Should new sleds be inserted? Installing sleds is not a skill the planner has yet, so this would need a person.
Does pulling these sleds need a latch or release lever opened first? If so, please show that in the 'pull drive sled' demonstration.
